title: The Bellman Behemoth
intro: Everything from Week 9: MDPs, returns, value functions, Bellman equations, Q-learning, SARSA, DQN, DDPG and overestimation bias.

questions.prompt: Part 1. What is $V^*(s_3)$ (one step from the goal)?
questions.scenario: **Scenario A (values on a chain).** A deterministic chain $s_1\to s_2\to s_3\to\text{goal}$. Every move gives reward 0 except the last move into the goal, which gives $+1$ and ends the episode. $\gamma=0.8$ and the optimal policy moves forward.

questions.prompt: *“Noisy Q-estimates have zero-mean error, so the max in the Bellman target is unbiased.”*
options: The max over noisy values is biased upward (overestimation), and training toward these targets compounds it
questions.explanation: Taking the best of noisy quotes.
